about: module fluid's mutants; each is judged by the module's tests and laws (scripts/examples -modules fluid), not by a compiler test. The law that kills each is named in its rule.

mutants.name: fl0-slug-collides
mutants.rule: Two components share a slug, so one has no page of its own: SlugParses (ParseComponent finds checkbox for checkbox-group's slug).

mutants.name: fl0-component-listed-twice
mutants.rule: The list names a component twice and drops another, so a page per entry renders one component twice and misses one: ListedOnce (and SlugParses for the dropped Card).

mutants.name: fl0-component-duplicated
mutants.rule: The list names a component twice and drops none: ListedOnce alone (SlugParses still finds every component).

mutants.name: fl0-foundation-slug-collides
mutants.rule: Two foundation pages share a slug: FoundationSlugParses.

mutants.name: fl3-clip-ends-short
mutants.from:
if c.Over <= 0ns || (!c.Repeat && ran >= c.Over) {
		return c.To
mutants.to:
if c.Over <= 0ns || (!c.Repeat && ran > c.Over) {
		return c.To
mutants.rule: A clip at its end time is eased, not at its target (a spring is 0.001 short there): EndsAtTarget (the spec's mutant: a clip that ends short of its target).

mutants.name: fl3-reduced-moves-repeating
mutants.rule: Reduced motion still moves a repeating clip (the spec's mutant): ReducedIsStill.

mutants.name: fl3-ended-ignores-reduced
mutants.rule: A host keeps ticking for clips reduced motion holds still: ReducedIsStill and NoTickWhenSettled.

mutants.name: fl3-curve-off-by-one-stop
mutants.rule: The printed linear() drops its last stop, so the browser's curve runs one step off (the spec's mutant): SheetCurveMatchesSpring.

mutants.name: fl3-too-few-stops
mutants.rule: Fewer stops put the browser's straight lines more than 0.002 off the spring: SheetCurveMatchesSpring (FL0's probe: 0.0026 at 60).

mutants.name: fl3-exit-slower
mutants.rule: An exit slower than its entrance: ExitIsQuicker.

mutants.name: fl3-spring-wrong-damping
mutants.rule: The closed form's decay drops the damping ratio, so it no longer solves the spring's equation: SpringSolvesItsEquation (and SettlesByItsDuration).

mutants.name: fl1-compact-not-smaller
mutants.rule: A compact control as tall as a comfortable one: CompactIsSmaller.

mutants.name: fl1-floating-as-raised
mutants.rule: A floating layer's shadow reaches no further than a raised one's, so a menu reads as a card: SurfacesRise.

mutants.name: fl1-dark-copied-from-light
mutants.from:
case Page:
		Pair{Light: Rgba{V: n50}, Dark: Rgba{V: n900}}
mutants.to:
case Page:
		Pair{Light: Rgba{V: n50}, Dark: Rgba{V: n50}}
mutants.rule: The dark page is the light page's value copied: EveryTokenHasBothSchemes.

mutants.name: fl1-override-leaks
mutants.rule: An override changes every token, not the one it names: ThemeIsTotal.

mutants.name: fl1-hover-is-rest
mutants.rule: A control's plate does not change under the pointer: LookIsTotal.

mutants.name: fl1-focus-ring-plain
mutants.rule: The keyboard focus ring is drawn in the edge colour, not the accent: FocusRingIsVisible.

mutants.name: fl1-disabled-full
mutants.rule: A disabled control is drawn at full opacity: DisabledIsDimmed.

mutants.name: fl1-merge-first-wins
mutants.from:
let mut all = slices.Clone(a.decls)
	for d in b.decls {
mutants.to:
let mut all = slices.Clone(b.decls)
	for d in a.decls {
mutants.rule: The first style's declaration wins a merge (still associative, so only LastWins sees it): LastWins.

mutants.name: fl1-wide-overlays-not-merged
mutants.rule: Two overlays at one width stay apart, so a box prints two atoms for one property at that width and the cascade picks: OneAtomPerKey.

mutants.name: fl1-classes-run-together
mutants.rule: A box's classes are printed with no separator, so none matches a rule: SheetCoversEveryLook.

mutants.name: fl1-token-prefix
mutants.rule: The token block defines properties the rules do not read: SheetNamesOnlyTokens.

mutants.name: fl1-sheet-rank-reversed
mutants.from:
if ra != rb {
			return ra - rb
mutants.to:
if ra != rb {
			return rb - ra
mutants.rule: The sheet prints a wide viewport's and a state's rules before the rest rule they override: SheetOrderIsRankOrder.

mutants.name: fl1-sheet-repeats-atoms
mutants.rule: An atom two looks share is printed twice: SheetIsOneRulePerDistinctDecl.

mutants.name: fl1-union-drops-group-looks
mutants.rule: The sheet leaves out the atoms of a look that marks a group (a control's root): SheetCoversEveryLook over the module's looks, and the gallery's cases.

mutants.name: fl1-components-out-of-order
mutants.rule: The components out of package order; at n = 1 the controls' declarations repeat little, so the sheet grows as fast as one class per look: SheetGrowsSlowerThanDeclarations.

mutants.name: fl1-style-is-reset-only
mutants.rule: A page's style element holds the reset and tokens but no rule: BuiltSheetIsSheet.

mutants.name: fl1-glyph-class-per-render
mutants.rule: A view resolves a look per render (the page's bytes are the same): ResolvedOncePerLook.
mutants.gap: equivalent once resolution is pure (FL-COUNTER, 2026-11-18): the view's web.Named of a constant look is a pure call with constant arguments, which the fold computes at build time; the counted guard ResolvedOncePerLook went with fluid/web's package counter, which kept every page that reached it from folding. Evidence: the button page folds to one constant (FL-COUNTER receipt).

mutants.name: fl1-theme-adds-rule
mutants.rule: A theme other than the default adds a rule to the sheet: ThemeChangesNoAtom (every other law builds its sheet under the default theme).

mutants.name: fl2-key-dot-unescaped
mutants.rule: A name's dot is not escaped, so the name "a.b" and the path a, b give one key: KeysAreUnique.

mutants.name: fl2-nameless-missed
mutants.rule: A press with no name and no text is not reported: EveryControlHasAName.

mutants.name: fl2-tab-needs-no-selection
mutants.rule: A tab need not state whether it is selected: RolesHaveRequiredStates.

mutants.name: fl2-button-selected
mutants.from: case part.Tab, part.Choice, part.Row, part.GridCell, part.ColumnHeader, part.RowHeader:
mutants.to: case part.Button, part.Tab, part.Choice, part.Row, part.GridCell, part.ColumnHeader, part.RowHeader:
mutants.rule: aria-selected is allowed on a button: StatesAreSupportedByRole.

mutants.name: fl2-native-needs-keys
mutants.rule: A native slider is flagged for having no keyboard map of its own: KeyedRolesHaveKeys.

mutants.name: fl2-unreachable-ok
mutants.rule: A button no focus reaches is not flagged: FocusKindIsStated.

mutants.name: fl2-named-generic-ok
mutants.rule: A generic box with a name is not flagged: NamelessRolesHaveNoName.

mutants.name: fl2-relation-dangles
mutants.rule: A relation to a dropped key is not flagged: RelationsResolve.

mutants.name: fl2-composite-no-stop-ok
mutants.rule: A tab list no Tab reaches is not flagged: OneTabStopPerComposite.

mutants.name: fl2-modal-hides-nothing
mutants.rule: The page behind a modal layer stays reachable (projector and Of agree, so only this law sees it): ModalHidesTheRest.

mutants.name: fl2-link-to-current-state
mutants.from: let next = StateHref(p.Path, p.Step(s, e)) catch {
mutants.rule: Every link leads to the current state: LinkIsStep.

mutants.name: fl2-disabled-press-links
mutants.from:
let dest = if a11yHas(p.Sem.States, part.Disabled) {
			None
mutants.rule: A press stated disabled that still sends is printed as a link: LinkIsStep (the laws' page's disabled tab), and AccessOfWebIsAccessOfPart when a seed draws one.

mutants.name: fl2-selected-on-wrong-tab
mutants.to: out = out.Append(html.Aria(a11y.StateName(st), if a11y.StateName(st) == "selected" { "false" } else { a11y.StateValue(st) }))
mutants.rule: The selected tab's markup says it is not selected (aria-selected on the wrong tab): AccessOfWebIsAccessOfPart.

mutants.name: fl2-state-href-other-page
mutants.rule: A state's URL is another page's (the state reads back, the path does not): StateRoundTrips.

mutants.name: fl2-short-names-collide
mutants.rule: Two atoms share a short name, so one rule styles both: NamesAreDistinct.

mutants.name: fl4-press-takes-mirror-signal
mutants.rule: Kids are drawn in reverse, so the i-th button sends another press's signal: PressSendsItsSignal (and AccessOfGuiIsAccessOfPart, by order).

mutants.name: fl4-key-binding-dropped
mutants.from: ui.OnKey(f, func(k ui.KeyPress) Option[E] { Bound[E](keys, k) })
mutants.to: ui.OnKey(f, func(k ui.KeyPress) Option[E] { Bound[E](keys, ui.KeyPress{..k, Name: ""}) })
mutants.rule: A keyed box's keyboard map sends nothing for a key it binds: PressSendsItsSignal.

mutants.name: fl4-expanded-always-open
mutants.rule: A collapsed box is told to a reader as expanded in the window: AccessOfGuiIsAccessOfPart.

mutants.name: fl4-paint-rest-only
mutants.to: look.Merge(l.Rest, look.Overlay(l, if true { look.Rest } else { st }))
mutants.rule: The paint is taken from the first of the two merged styles, the rest style, and the state's overlay is dropped: HostsResolveAlike.

mutants.name: fl4-dark-painted-light
mutants.rule: A dark scheme is painted with the light value: HostsResolveAlike.

mutants.name: ts-class-renamed-one-side
mutants.rule: The island's table names a control root by another naming than the sheet's (renamed on one side only): TableNamesOnlySheetClasses.

mutants.name: ts-tone-missing-from-sheet
mutants.to: for t in []look.Tone{look.Solid, look.Soft, look.Outline, look.Bare} {
mutants.rule: The module's looks drop a tone, so the sheet lacks it while the island's table still offers it: TableNamesOnlySheetClasses.

mutants.name: ts-island-own-naming
mutants.rule: The island module names its classes from the module's looks alone, so it brings a second sheet whose short names collide with the page's: IslandUsesThePageSheet.

mutants.name: mg-retarget-drops-speed
mutants.from: Target: to, X0: Pos(k, t), V0: Vel(k, t), Start: t}
mutants.to: Target: to, X0: Pos(k, t), V0: 0.0 * Vel(k, t), Start: t}
mutants.rule: A retarget resets velocity to 0, so a value turned mid-flight stops dead: TracesAreSmooth.

mutants.name: mg-retarget-from-target
mutants.from: Target: to, X0: Pos(k, t), V0: Vel(k, t), Start: t}
mutants.to: Target: to, X0: k.Target + 0.0 * Pos(k, t), V0: Vel(k, t), Start: t}
mutants.rule: A retarget starts from the old target, not from where the value is (a jump): TracesAreSmooth.

mutants.name: mg-track-twice-frequency
mutants.rule: A track's spring runs at twice the clip's frequency (still smooth and settled, but not the clip's motion): TrackIsTheClipSpring.
